contact.evidence_quote: The Holland Scholarship is financed by the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and Dutch research universities and universities of applied sciences. The scholarship is intended for international students from outside the European Economic Area (EEA) who want to do their bachelor's or master's in the Netherlands. EEA refers to EU countries plus Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway. Nationals of Switzerland and Suriname are not eligible for this scholarship programme either. ... This scholarship is dedicated to Arnoud van Delft , founder of the Fast Track programme. The Arnoud van Delft scholarship is offered to the best Fast-track talent and is awarded annually. The selected Fast Track student will receive upfront credit for the costs of the Preparation course, which amount to €3,380.
